# FLAC encoder notice

Windows distributions of Listenook include `flac.exe` and, for x64,
`libFLAC.dll` from FLAC 1.5.0. The command-line encoder is licensed under
GPL-2.0-or-later; libFLAC uses the adjacent Xiph license.

The unmodified FLAC 1.5.0 source archive is included as
`flac-1.5.0.tar.xz` in the Windows distribution's `third_party` directory.
Build provenance and SHA-256 checksums are recorded in `flac-manifest.json`.

- Project: https://xiph.org/flac/
- Source: https://github.com/xiph/flac/releases/tag/1.5.0
